purpose: Teach: 突撃/下半身/名言/セレブ/鍼/歌舞伎町/ベッカム/旅人

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ゲームで突撃しすぎだぞ
lines.en: You're charging in way too hard in games, Riku.
lines.style: Teasing, knowing. Light jab—caught him doing something predictable. Quick pace, amused undertone. The eye-roll you deliver as a friend.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、下半身の筋トレ始めたな、桜
lines.en: And you started doing lower-body workouts, Sakura.
lines.style: Observation fired back with a small smile. Not defensive—returning serve. Warm beneath the banter. Pace steady and even, like he's been waiting to mention it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、名言メモ集めてるな
lines.en: You're collecting quote notes now, huh, Riku?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity breaking through the teasing. Softer than before—she actually noticed and is asking. Slight lift at the end, inviting him to explain.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、セレブのSNSフォローしすぎだろ、桜
lines.en: You follow way too many celebrities on social media, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry comeback. Leveling the field with the same amused observation she gave. Cool-distant mask back on, but the timing shows he's been watching her too.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、母さんに鍼治療勧められてたな
lines.en: Your mom was recommending acupuncture to you, wasn't she, Riku?
lines.style: Caught-you tone, but gentler this time. Less teasing, more genuine concern peeking through. Slightly slower. The words of someone who notices when someone's hurting.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、歌舞伎町近づくなって父さんに言われたろ?桜
lines.en: Your dad told you to stay away from Kabuki-cho, didn't he, Sakura?
lines.style: Deflecting with a counter-observation. Keeping it light but there's weight underneath—he knows something about her life she hasn't said out loud. Even rhythm, not dwelling on it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ベッカム選手のフリーキック真似してたな
lines.en: You were mimicking Beckham's free kicks the other day, Riku.
lines.style: Genuine admiration breaking through. No teasing this time—just noticing something he did well. Warmer tone, slower pace. Almost proud.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、卒業したら旅人になりたいって言ってたな、桜
lines.en: You said after graduation you wanted to become a traveler, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet, reflective. Not teasing anymore—this is him really listening, remembering something she said that mattered. Gentle cadence. Trailing off slightly, like he's sitting with what it means.
